24.09.2026 UKHC010149292026
SPA No. 359 of 2026
Deepak Saini ---- appellant
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & ors ---- respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J. 
1. Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for 
the appellant.
2. Mr. Ganesh Dutt Kandpal, learned 
Additional Advocate General for the State.
3. Learned State counsel has placed on 
record the instructions received from the State 
Government, which does not indicate that any 
objective criteria has been laid down to examine 
whether or not character certificate should be 
granted. The only instruction submitted is that 
it is based on the report of the concerned police 
station.
4. We grant two weeks’ further time to the 
State counsel to seek further instructions on the 
said aspect.
5. List after two weeks.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
